title: Applicant Tenant: Noel Quinn – Respondent Landlord: Douglas Pye, Marie Louise Pye
text:
Residential Tenancies Board

Determination Order

Ref: DR0917-37426

In the matter of Noel Quinn [Applicant Tenant] and Douglas Pye, Marie Louise Pye
[Respondent Landlords] the Residential Tenancies Board, in accordance with section 121 of
the Residential Tenancies Act 2004, determines that:

1. The Notice of Termination served by the Respondent Landlords on 17 October 2016
on the Applicant Tenant in respect of the tenancy of the dwelling at 86 Millview Lawns,
Malahide, County Dublin is valid.

2. The Respondent Landlords shall pay the total sum of €1,800 to the Applicant Tenant,
within 28 days of the date of issue of this Order, being the balance of the unjustifiably
retained security deposit of €2,300.00 having deducted €500.00 for damage to the
dwelling in excess of ordinary wear and tear together, in respect of the tenancy of the
above dwelling.

This Order was made by the Residential Tenancies Board on 23 January 2018.

Paddy Gray 3 j 2 Claire Diggin

Board Member Higher Executive Officer
